purpose: Select one economically independent no-return mechanism after the major-contract signing-date schema rejection, without reopening a consumed branch or searching titles, formulas, directions, ages, fields, weights, or subsets against provider rows or returns.

pre_row_contract_correction.reason: The original all-literals rule incorrectly assumed every ordinary plan-draft title contains the literal 股权激励计划. The frozen category also covers the standard plan-type literals 限制性股票激励计划 and 股票期权激励计划, so the rule is corrected before source access to require 草案 plus exactly the disclosed title containing at least one of the three preregistered plan-type literals.

frontier_decisions.reason: The adjacent CNInfo guarantee thematic endpoint already returned object-shaped records where the pinned thematic adapter required positional arrays. The lawsuit route uses the same positional thematic family and needs a separately justified transport contract rather than a post-failure reinterpretation.

Treating no recent risk-warning disclosure as a favorable full-market score would require proving exhaustive category coverage and would leave a mostly tied zero cross-section; restricting the score to event issuers would not provide a coherent positive-selection mechanism.

The provider-generated participation, attention, and desire scores are black-box transformations with unclear historical revision semantics and would reintroduce price, attention, and sentiment overlap.

A newly disclosed equity-incentive plan draft is a dated governance and compensation-alignment event. Strict title classification can isolate the initial plan draft without grant, vesting, exercise, amendment, cancellation, ownership, price, or financial-statement fields.

economic_independence.distinct_from_insider_open_market_transa: Insider transactions are realized personal market purchases or sales; an incentive-plan draft is a company compensation-governance design and uses no transaction direction, size, price, or identity.
economic_independence.distinct_from_management_continuity: Management continuity attempted to measure departures and tenure; this candidate measures a new compensation-alignment plan and requests no manager name or departure date.
economic_independence.distinct_from_holder_and_pledge_factors: The event is neither an observed shareholder position, ownership concentration change, pledge, nor major-holder trade.
economic_independence.distinct_from_financial_statements_forec: No accounting amount, earnings guidance, grant, subsidy, customer contract, revenue, or asset field enters the mechanism.
economic_independence.distinct_from_prices_moneyflow_and_analy: No OHLCV, return, order flow, valuation, market capitalization, analyst opinion, or vendor sentiment score enters the mechanism.

selected_candidate.source_event_measure: initial_equity_incentive_plan_disclosure_count = number of globally unique complete qualifying plan-draft announcement identities for one supported instrument and announcement_date
selected_candidate.interpretation: More distinct newly disclosed initial equity-incentive plan drafts and greater freshness indicate a stronger near-term compensation-alignment catalyst.
selected_candidate.availability: first local trading session strictly after the Asia/Shanghai calendar announcement date regardless of intraday timestamp
selected_candidate.multiple_event_dates: Use only the latest already-effective announcement date; a later effective event supersedes an older event.
selected_candidate.future_entry_if_admitted: next local session open after signal-close ranking

prohibited_post_result_actions: change the title literal groups or announcement identity after observing a row
drop, fill, coerce, infer, or reinterpret incomplete titles, ids, codes, or timestamps
switch from initial plan drafts to grants, vesting, exercise, amendments, cancellations, employee stock-ownership plans, quantities, prices, targets, or dilution
change direction, three-calendar-day age, samples, thresholds, or point-in-time timing
retry a consumed acceptance or failed partition
reuse or repair the management-continuity, insider-trade, holder, pledge, or major-contract mechanisms
read prices or returns before a separately frozen no-return capacity and uniqueness gate
aggregate, score, select, size, order, or justify Level-2 from acceptance evidence
